name: Process Timing 6
definition: Parameters defining the timing conditions to process an action.

StartTime.name: Start Time
StartTime.definition: Date and time to start the action.

EndTime.name: End Time
EndTime.definition: Date and time after which the action cannot be processed.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Period delay between cyclic action activation in months, days, hours and minutes, leading zeros could be omitted.

UnitOfTime.name: Unit Of Time
UnitOfTime.definition: Identification of the minimum unit of time used by time configuration parameters.
